description: This file defines the dmUtility class which provides various static utility functions for string manipulation, query parsing, and property handling used in the project.

classes.name: dmUtility
classes.description: A utility class providing static functions for string parsing, manipulation, and query handling.

methods.name: void splitQuery(char const * query,char * parameter)
methods.description: Splits a query string to extract the last segment after the last period or backslash.

methods.name: bool has_suffix(const std::string & str,const std::string & suffix)
methods.description: Checks if a string has a specific suffix.

methods.name: bool isWildcard(char const * s)
methods.description: Determines if the given string ends with a period, indicating a wildcard.

methods.name: std::string trimWildcard(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes trailing period from a string if present.

methods.name: std::string trimProperty(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Trims the property name from a string object, removing the last dot and following substring.

methods.name: std::string trimPropertyName(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Retrieves only the property name after the last dot.

methods.name: std::string trimSetProperty(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Handles trimming of property set expressions, especially multi-set syntax.

methods.name: bool parseMultisetValue(std::string const & s,std::vector<std::pair<std::string,std::string>> & nameVals)
methods.description: Parses a multiset string representation into name-value pairs.

methods.name: void splitString(std::string const & s,char delim,std::vector<std::string> & out)
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on a delimiter character.
